description: This file contains unit tests for the QuicIntervalSet class in the QUIC protocol implementation, testing interval operations such as union, intersection, difference, complement, and various constructors.

classes.description: Test fixture class for testing QuicIntervalSet functionalities.

classes.name: NotOstreamable
classes.description: A class with no ostream support, used to test template handling.

classes.description: Test fixture class for testing various constructors and assignment methods of QuicIntervalSet.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes interval sets with predefined ranges for testing.
